The server now identifies itself to the AtlasFetch API, so we can see how many lookups come through MCP.

## Changed

- **Requests carry a User-Agent**: `atlasfetch-mcp/0.1.4 (+https://github.com/atlasfetch-dev/atlasfetch-mcp)`. The API keeps only the `atlasfetch-mcp/0.1.4` part, alongside the endpoint, key and timestamp it already records. Nothing about you or your machine is sent, and coordinates you look up are still never stored.
- Tools, schemas and behaviour are unchanged from 0.1.3.

## Install

**Claude Desktop** — download `atlasfetch-0.1.4.mcpb` below and open it. The API key field is optional.

**Claude Code**

```
claude mcp add atlasfetch -- npx -y atlasfetch-mcp
```

**Other clients** — `npx -y atlasfetch-mcp`, with `ATLASFETCH_API_KEY` in the server's env. See the [README](https://github.com/atlasfetch-dev/atlasfetch-mcp#install).

No signup needed to try it: without a key it uses a shared demo key capped at 1,000 lookups a month across everyone using it. Get your own limits with a free sign-up at [atlasfetch.xyz](https://atlasfetch.xyz/dashboard).
